1
Using Word Hug
By installing the app you agree to these terms. There's no account to create and nothing to sign. Use the app for your own enjoyment; don't try to break it, extract the puzzle database, automate solving, or republish puzzles as your own. If you do, we may stop the app working for you.
2
Purchases & refunds
The daily puzzle is free. Hug Packs and nudge coins are one-off purchases made through Apple or Google — not subscriptions, and they don't expire. A pack you buy stays available on any device signed in to the same store account; use Restore purchases to bring it back.
Refunds are handled by the store that took your payment. We can't issue them ourselves, but if something went wrong, email us and we'll help you make the request.
Prices are shown by your app store in your own currency and may change. Nudge coins have no cash value, can't be transferred, and aren't refundable once spent on a nudge.
3
Your progress
Solves, streaks and coin balances live on your device, so deleting the app or losing the phone loses them, and we can't recover them. Purchases are the exception — those can always be restored. Streaks are a keepsake, not a currency: they can't be bought, repaired, or traded.
4
Our content
The puzzles, artwork, name and design of Word Hug belong to us. Buying a pack gives you a personal licence to play it, not ownership of the puzzles. Screenshots for reviews, articles, social posts and videos are welcome and need no permission.
5
Availability
We intend to keep publishing a puzzle every day, but we're two people — occasionally something breaks. The app is offered as it is. If we ever have to stop the daily puzzle, we'll say so in the app well ahead of time, and packs you've bought will keep working offline.
6
Liability
Word Hug is a word game. To the extent the law allows, we aren't liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from using it, and our total liability is limited to what you've paid us in the previous twelve months. Nothing here limits rights you have as a consumer that can't be limited.
Law & changes
These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. If we change them we'll update the date above and note what changed; continuing to use the app means you accept the new version. Questions to hello@wordhug.app.
